name: jack-cheng-marketplace
description: Jack Cheng's Claude Code plugins: small, install-what-you-need plugins for prompting, code review, git shipping and HTML explainers, plus reading & writing skills from 《写作的真相》.

plugins.name: jack-prompting
plugins.description: Work on the prompt before any code: jack-ask (router), jack-meta-think (diagnose the question), jack-prompt-master (two-round self-refinement meta-prompting), jack-loop-prompt (paste-ready long-run prompts).

plugins.name: jack-engineering
plugins.description: Claude-native code and plan audits (jack-audit-fable, jack-review-plan-fable), GitHub issue auto-fix (jack-auto-fix), remote branch cleanup (jack-audit-branches).

plugins.name: jack-git
plugins.description: Conventional Commits, pull requests and GitHub releases with the gh CLI: gh-commit, gh-pr, gh-release.

plugins.name: jack-html-preview
plugins.description: Turn a folder, repo, or Markdown file into one self-contained interactive HTML explainer.

plugins.name: songy-course-exporter
plugins.description: Export a Songy web course from a course URL or the open authenticated Songy page.

plugins.name: writing-truth
plugins.description: Reading & writing skills from Li Xiaolai's 《写作的真相》: dissect-author-mind (L1), logic-template-lens (L4), rhetoric-lens (L5).

plugins.name: jack-work
plugins.description: Knowledge-work skills for research and consulting output: interview-notes incrementally syncs raw interview transcripts into a consolidated Q&A memo, strictly additively.
